enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn onto right side. Bend knees. Place hand under pillow. Turn onto back. Stretch arms. Turn onto left side. Pull blanket up to chin. Adjust pillow. Move feet. Turn onto right side. Breathe deeply. Turn onto back. Stretch legs. Turn onto left side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Sleep.

Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Swing legs over edge. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Dry face with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal box. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Close cabinet. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Open drawer. Take out spoon. Close drawer. Sit at table. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk. Stand up. Carry bowl to sink. Rinse bowl. Place bowl in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open closet door. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close closet door. Take off pajama top. Take off pajama bottoms. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Put on pants. Zip pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Tie shoelaces. Look in mirror. Adjust collar. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Place bag on lap. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a community program coordinator
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at office. Greet colleague. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Attend meeting. Take notes. Make phone calls. Talk to clients. Write reports. Print documents. Organize files. Meet with team. Discuss project.
Leave office. Walk to cafe. Enter cafe. Order sandwich. Pay cashier. Receive food. Find table. Sit down. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Stand up. Throw trash. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a community program coordinator
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Type document. Attend conference call. Speak on phone. Organize files. Meet with team. Discuss project. Send emails. Review budget. Write proposal. Make copies. File documents. Return phone calls. Update database.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Listen to music. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home.

Enter kitchen. Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out chicken. Close refrigerator. Place vegetables on cutting board. Cut vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Take plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Carry plate to sink. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Stop on news. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel. Watch movie.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on personal tasks on computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Enter password. Open browser. Check email. Open document. Type text. Save document. Open spreadsheet. Enter data. Close laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Leisure time, reading or watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up book from shelf. Sit on couch. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read more. Close book. Put book down. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Watch show. Adjust volume. Change channel. Watch another show.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush. Wash hands. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Dry face. Apply moisturizer. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.
Enter bedroom. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Turn to other side. Stretch legs. Pull blanket up. Sleep.
